steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each shift is placed by its cover for the required roles and whether each missed punch was corrected.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 shift has no cover for a required role

findings.title: Shift with no cover for a required role
findings.fix: Arrange cover before the shift starts

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] shift-day-2.csv:12  Shift with no cover for a required role.
       Fix: Arrange cover before the shift starts.
[medium] cover-rules.md:19  Missed punch with no correction.
       Fix: Record the correction.
[low] corrections.csv:26  Late arrival not explained.
       Fix: Record the reason.
Not checked: Cover arranged outside the roster.
pros: Checks a shift with no cover for a required role, and a missed punch with no correction.
cons: Not checked: Cover arranged outside the roster.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hr-shift-exceptions skill on the records for this review.
